COD.rationale: Content (red positions), organization (origin), and a separate status/field are all present for p0/current/n0.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit represented contents with attributes (color-labeled position sets).

D.rationale: Content lines and separate origin/status lines are both present for the same named unit, distinguishing identity from organization/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented/organized (origin/inherited/current) for current and candidate entries.
